edges.notes: DragonFly BSD libc implements C and POSIX interfaces for hosted C on DragonFly triplets.
DragonFly libc and the dynamic linker participate in ELF dynamic linking on supported architectures.
GCC in DragonFly dports/base toolchains commonly links against DragonFly libc.
GNU ld links against libc in typical DragonFly ELF flows.
Clang/LLVM may be used in dports and link against libc where configured.
